isCompleted.description: Indicates whether the task is completed or not.

id.description: Unique identifier for the SuggestedTaskName entity.

category.description: The category of the suggested task.

definition.description: Stores tasks owned by a specific user. Uses path-based ownership for security. No denormalization required due to the selected ownership model.

params.name: userId
params.description: The ID of the user who owns the task.

definition.description: Stores globally available suggested task names.  Accessible to all users.

params.name: suggestedTaskNameId
params.description: The ID of the suggested task name.

firestore.reasoning: The Firestore structure is designed to follow best practices for security, scalability, and debuggability, prioritizing Authorization Independence.  Since tasks are owned by individual users, we use path-based ownership for the `tasks` collection. Suggested task names are global and accessible to all users, so they reside in a top-level collection. This design ensures clarity of ownership and avoids complex authorization rules. To ensure Authorization Independence (Strategy A), no denormalization is needed because of the selected ownership model. QAPs are supported because listing tasks under `/users/{userId}/tasks` is inherently secure due to path-based ownership.
